title: Anima 固定视觉 Token 数

standard.summary: 将训练的视觉 token（图像 patch 序列）长度固定为指定值，避免因批内图像尺寸不同导致的变长序列重编译开销。
standard.effect: 固定后所有 batch 使用相同序列长度（不足的填 padding），torch.compile 可以稳定工作而不频繁重编译。
standard.whenToUse: 开启 torch.compile 时推荐同时固定 token 数以获得稳定的编译加速。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据集图像尺寸差异极大时，固定 token 数会浪费 padding 显存（对最大图像外的其他图像）。

standard_en.summary: Fixes the length of the trained visual token sequence (the image patch sequence) to a given value, avoiding the recompile cost of variable-length sequences when images in a batch differ in size.
standard_en.effect: Once fixed, every batch uses the same sequence length -- shorter ones are padded -- so torch.compile can work steadily instead of recompiling constantly.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended alongside torch.compile: fixing the token count is what makes the compiled speed-up stable.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When image sizes in the dataset vary enormously, a fixed token count wastes padding VRAM on every image but the largest.

advanced.principle: Anima DiT 的 forward 接受变长 token 序列；固定后统一填充到 max_len，Dynamo 可以编译固定形状的计算图，避免每个新形状触发重编译（graph break）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 固定到最大尺寸会浪费小图的计算（padding 位置的计算是无效的），但配合 attention mask 可以避免 padding 影响结果。

advanced_en.principle: Anima DiT's forward accepts variable-length token sequences; fixing them pads everything to max_len so Dynamo can compile a fixed-shape graph, avoiding recompilation (graph breaks) on every new shape.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Fixing at the maximum size wastes compute on small images (padding positions compute nothing useful), but with an attention mask padding does not affect results.
